final: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount * 1.0, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS category_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(category_count) AS avg_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(c.avg_ratio) AS avg_category_ratio, AVG(c.category_count) AS avg_category_count, AVG(c.category_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM category_stats AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND c.category_count > o.avg_count
